title_original: ‘Iron Jane’ Adds Rafael Casal, Alexandra Metz, Jesse Garcia, Nicholas Gonzalez & Lenda Murray As Production Wraps; Victoria Alonso To Produce
excerpt_original: EXCLUSIVE: The Eiza González and Brandon Sklenar-led feature film Iron Jane has wrapped production in Atlanta and Las Vegas, with additional cast revealed: Rafael Casal (The Lowdown, Blindspotting), Alexandra Metz (The Pitt, Will Trent), Jesse Garcia (The Odyssey, Flamin’ Hot),…

blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE: The Eiza González and Brandon Sklenar-led feature film Iron Jane has wrapped production in Atlanta and Las Vegas, with additional cast revealed: Rafael Casal ( The Lowdown , Blindspotting ), Alexandra Metz ( The Pitt , Will Trent) , Jesse Garcia ( The Odyssey, Flamin’ Hot ), Nicholas Gonzalez ( The Good Doctor, Resurrection Blvd ), and Lenda Murray, eight-time Ms. Olympia Champion, who will also executive produce.

Additionally, Victoria Alonso of Mapuche Films has joined the filmmaking team, bringing experience from her years at Marvel Studios producing films from franchises including Iron Man, Avengers, Guardians of the Galaxy, Black Panther, and many more.

blocks.alt: Lisa Vidal, Aaron Dominguez, Jesse Garcia, Edwin Hodge, Emilio Rivera, Adam Rodriguez and Javon Walton

blocks.text: Written and directed by Lissette Feliciano, Iron Jane follows Janie John (González), who, after a childhood shaped by neglect and invisibility, is pulled into a world that finally sees her, where pain is power and bodies are built, not born. Female bodybuilding offers her something she’s never had: the chance to become untouchable. Coached by a former champion (Sklenar), she begins an extreme transformation, pushing her body past its limits through relentless training, enhancers, and dependence. As her physique sharpens, Janie rises fast, but her grip on reality fractures. Trapped in a system that rewards perfection and punishes weakness, Janie spirals toward a godlike ideal that’s slowly destroying her from within.

Andrea Bucko of Sugar Rush Pictures, Alonso via Mapuche Films, Sklenar via his Vista Lane Pictures, Jay Glazer of Neon Kite, Matt Cooper and Anna Dragoo of OGM, Ford Corbett of Gramercy Park, Nathan Klingher, Feliciano via her Look at the Moon Pictures, and González are producing. Sweetheart Entertainment and Gramercy Park are financing.

Executive producers include Joshua Harris, Cassian Elwes, Nicky Weinstock, Scott Lambert, Maria Breese, Ari Adlerstein, Tyler Savage, Tyler Smith, Sophie Curtis, Peter Jaffe, Lenda Murray, and Foxey Films. Highland Film Group is handling international sales. CAA Media Finance and WME Independent rep U.S. rights.

Casal is represented by CAA and Brillstein Entertainment Partners. Metz is repped by Link and Franklin, Weinrib, Rudell & Vassallo. Garcia is repped by Mosaic, Independent Artist Group and Sloane, Offer, Weber and Dern. González is represented by CAA, Linden Entertainment and Jackoway Austen Tyerman.
